scope: maturity processor and model-specific feedback-state contract; architecture/OT/optimizer/default stopping unchanged
training: gradient batches use only labels mature before train segment cutoff; chronological evaluation predicts all D-known train nodes and masks unavailable labels only in metrics
validation: all D-known validation nodes retained; metric labels mature before validation cutoff only; new chronological causal queue for each validation pass
outer: annual model starts a fresh queue; only expert outputs actually emitted by that frozen model during Outer feed its router after true maturity; no in-sample historical fitted error state carried into Outer
segment_state: independent train/validation/test buffers; never transfer train fitted predictions into validation or Outer as if historical OOF
author21_recency_exclusion: retained in addition to actual exit-based maturity mask
reference: unmodified original public implementation continues separately
